scenarios.desc: New normative line added to a governance file with no evidence
scenarios.input: I am adding a new line to .agents/governance/PROJECT-CONSTRAINTS.md saying agents MUST run the linter before every commit. I have not linked a source for it. What does the line need before review, and how will a reviewer check it? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 4: every added or changed normative line under .agents/governance/ needs one nearby evidence anchor (Source line, Refs issue or PR, ADR link, retrospective link, or Why paragraph) in the same section. Reviewers verify with git diff -U3 -- .agents/governance/.

scenarios.desc: Removing a security review requirement from governance
scenarios.input: The code review step in .agents/governance/PROJECT-CONSTRAINTS.md slows the team down. I want to delete the security review requirement and the link that justified it. What does that change need? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST NOT 1 forbids reducing security or review requirements without a unanimous-consensus ADR. MUST NOT 2 forbids removing the evidence link of an existing rule; supersession needs a new ADR, not silent deletion.

scenarios.desc: Cross-role governance change with auto-merge requested
scenarios.input: I edited .agents/governance/CONSENSUS.md to change how the architect and implementer roles vote, and I want the PR to auto-merge once CI is green. How do I get this through? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 1 requires human maintainer approval and prohibits auto-merge for governance files. MUST 3 requires the CONSENSUS.md protocol with domain-weighted voting (security gets 2.0x on security decisions) for changes affecting multiple roles. MUST 5 bars unilateral changes by one specialist agent.

scenarios.desc: New constraint landing in governance files
scenarios.input: I am adding a new constraint about worktree cleanup as a new file .agents/governance/WORKTREE-CLEANUP.md. Where else do I record it and how should I word the requirements? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: SHOULD 1 says PROJECT-CONSTRAINTS.md is the index of record and new constraints land there with details in a dedicated file. SHOULD 2 says to cross-link from AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. SHOULD 3 says to use MUST / SHOULD / MAY.

scenarios.input: I am writing a new analysis note at .agents/analysis/cache-miss-investigation.md summarizing why the CI cache missed last week. Outline the sections it needs. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The rule scopes to .agents/governance/**. A sibling .agents/analysis/ path is an adjacent area that does not carry the human-approval, ADR, or consensus requirements.

scenarios.desc: Python script that reads a governance file (negative)
scenarios.input: scripts/validation/check_constraints_index.py reads .agents/governance/PROJECT-CONSTRAINTS.md and crashes on an empty file. I am only changing the Python reader, not the governance file. Outline the fix. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The rule binds edits to files under .agents/governance/. Editing a script that only reads the file leaves every governance file unchanged, so no approval, ADR, or consensus step applies.
